intended_use: Mechanism pilot only. Same-L3 skills may contain source-specific targets and parameters.

skills.belief: For this same-L3 pilot, start from the unplanted HEINONG84 standard-density field. Establishment requires weather/forecast/soil/resource checks, field prep, base fertilizer, 1.1 m ridges, and whole-field planting with the source L3 parameters.
skills.action_pattern: level field, load 360 kg base fertilizer, base_fertilize, form 1.1 m ridges, plant HEINONG84 ridges 0-63 in 4-ridge blocks at depth_cm=4.0 and seed_spacing_cm=7.9, commit physics, recheck planted field
constraints: do not plant before field prep, base fertilizer, and ridge formation
use HEINONG84 for this source L3
same-L3 exact spacing/depth/ridge-width parameters are not fair cross-L3 context

skills.belief: Use fungicide only after disease evidence is confirmed by weather/soil/canopy context, drone localization, target-vs-reference state, and ground crop-health check.
skills.action_pattern: wait/recheck spray window, load fungicide, apply targeted fungicide blocks, recheck disease state and budget
constraints: do not use fungicide for insect, weed, nutrient, or water stress

skills.belief: After fungicide, insect pressure is a separate R5 diagnosis. Manual insecticide is appropriate only when insect evidence and resource checks support it.
skills.action_pattern: recheck action readiness, use manual insecticide on the confirmed insect block, recheck insect pressure
constraints: do not treat insects with fungicide
manual path is for this source scenario's wet/trafficability and budget context

skills.belief: At R8, wait/recheck until weather, trafficability, grain moisture, and storage capacity support harvest and direct storage.
skills.action_pattern: wait to safe moisture, harvest 0-63 in 4-ridge blocks, unload, store, recheck inventory
constraints: direct store only when moisture is safe
